room_rent.note: Policy wording does not specify a room-rent cap or entitlement tier; no sub-limit table found in the wording for room rent.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under hospitalisation SI but no specific cap stated in wording.

copayment.note: No co-payment clause found in the base policy wording.

sub_limits.display: Maternity, OPD, Physiotherapy, Organ Donor, Air Ambulance, Recovery benefit capped; hospitalisation at SI
sub_limits.note: Hospitalisation (incl. pre/post/road ambulance/day care/AYUSH) capped at hospitalisation SI. Separate sub-limits for maternity (₹25k–₹35k), OPD (₹2.5k–₹5k), physiotherapy (₹5k–₹10k), organ donor (₹50k–₹1L), air ambulance (₹50k–₹1L), recovery benefit (₹10k). No disease-wise sub-limits on core hospitalisation.

deductible.note: No deductible mentioned for these plans.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, fistula, stones, etc.) have 12-month waiting period. Certain conditions (joint replacement, DNS, congenital internal, Parkinson's, refractive error correction, genetic disorders) have 24-month wait.

maternity.note: Inbuilt; limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime; Plan A ₹25k, Plan B ₹30k, Plan C ₹35k per delivery. Includes new born baby cover. Both self & spouse must be covered under same policy.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year; max 50% of SI over 5 years. Reduced by 10% on a claim year but base SI preserved.

restoration.note: 100% of hospitalisation SI reinstated once per policy period after full exhaustion; only for subsequent claims not arising from same illness/disease as the exhausting claim.

day_care.note: Indicative list of 130 procedures provided; other procedures qualifying under day-care definition also covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined in the policy but not listed as a covered benefit under Section C.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered within overall hospitalisation SI; must be in government hospital.

organ_donor.note: Plan A ₹50k, Plan B ₹80k, Plan C ₹1L lump sum for harvesting expenses.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed at actuals within overall hospitalisation SI. Air ambulance separate: Plan A ₹50k, Plan B ₹80k, Plan C ₹1L.

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intra vitreal injections, HIFU, deep brain stimulation etc. covered up to base SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed in Annexure II are explicitly excluded (gloves, masks, etc.).

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India not covered under medical expenses section. PA and CI covers apply worldwide but payment in India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud and permanent exclusions.

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, non-medical consumables, IVF/ART/surrogacy, refractive error <7.5D, external congenital anomalies, ectopic pregnancy (covered under hosp SI)
optional_riders: Ancillary Expenses (daily allowance + ICU allowance), Critical Illness cover (15 CIs), Personal Accident cover (Death/PTD/PPD/TTD)
variant_note: Sold as three named bands (Vital, Smart, Ultimo) that differ only by sum insured; the policy terms, waiting periods and co-payment are identical across all three.
